trades.reasoning: AAPL shows all four confirming signals — RSI 62.4 in the bullish zone, MACD bullish crossover, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge — suggesting real institutional participation rather than a neutral-day blip.

decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.3%, S&P500 -0.1%), so we held back from aggressively deploying cash but made one selective buy in AAPL, which had the strongest multi-signal confirmation (volume surge plus trend and momentum alignment) among the candidates. The rest of the portfolio was left untouched since existing positions are performing well and stop-loss/profit-target rules will handle exits automatically.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded in a narrow range today with no clear directional catalyst, as the NASDAQ edged up 0.3% while the S&P 500 slipped 0.1%. This kind of sideways action typically reflects investors digesting recent gains and waiting for the next earnings or macro data point before committing new capital. Without a strong signal in either direction, large-cap tech names like AAPL that showed volume-backed momentum stood out from the broader flat tape.
market_education.summary_zh: 大型指數今日窄幅波動，缺乏明確方向，納指微升0.3%，標普500則下跌0.1%。這種橫盤走勢通常反映投資者在消化近期升幅，並等待下一個業績或宏觀數據作為指引。在大盤缺乏方向之際，像AAPL這類有成交量支持的大型科技股動能表現就顯得格外突出。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Volume confirmation means checking that a price move is backed by higher-than-normal trading activity, which signals real buying interest rather than a random fluctuation. Today AAPL stood out because its bullish price and momentum signals came with a volume surge, making the setup more trustworthy than similar-looking candidates without that extra confirmation.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 成交量確認是指核實價格變動是否伴隨著高於平常的交易量，這代表背後有真實的買盤支持，而不是隨機波動。今日AAPL之所以突出，是因為其利好的價格和動能信號同時伴隨成交量大增，相比其他沒有這項確認的候選股，其走勢更為可信。
